message.content: In Christian theology, **Jesus Christ** is regarded as the most significant prophetic figure. While the Old Testament contains many prophets—Moses, Isaiah, Jeremiah, etc.—Christian doctrine teaches that Jesus is the fulfillment of those prophecies and the ultimate messenger of God. He is seen as the culmination of the prophetic tradition, bringing the promises of the Hebrew Scriptures to completion. Thus, although Jesus is also understood as the Son of God and the Savior, he is simultaneously viewed as the supreme prophet who delivers God's final revelation to humanity.
